items.question: Run-level verification before more splits (item 3): run a built VI (D1_s3_loop15 / D1_s4_loop17) under supervision or on recorded frames, and compare X/Y/Z with the original?
options: supervised run with the user present
keep splitting, verify at the end
items.answer: Real run of the assembled VI is the acceptance test; recorded-frame replay only when needed (user 2026-09-24)

items.question: Outcome review steering: should a repeated outcome verdict issue a steering card the judgement must follow or reject with evidence (two rejections stop the runner)? To discuss with item 3.
items.answer: yes as proposed: steering card, two refusals stop the runner (user 2026-09-24)

items.question: Real runs at 1/3/6 beads for 35 s lose only 2-11 of ~3,075 frames in BOTH the original (no TIFF writer) and the split VI, so the split shows no gain at this load. How many beads and how long does a real experiment use, so we benchmark a realistic load?
options: 20 or more beads, runs of 10+ minutes
load does not matter; keep the split for the no-serial-on-frame-path rule
items.recommendation: tell us the typical bead count and run length; the split stays on course either way because of the no-serial rule
items.answer: User: typically 8 beads, sometimes 15. Frame loss already appears intermittently at 90 Hz and grows at 150 Hz; the user wants the maximum frame rate possible (SP-5000M: a smaller ROI raises the rate). Benchmark at 8 and 15 beads, 90 and 150 Hz, and a reduced ROI.

items.question: Requirement 1 includes the bead-profile calibration (.cal) stage. No cycle has touched it since 2026-08-24. Is it in scope for this project, or does it stay as it is in the original?
options: in scope: split it out like the other loops
out of scope: keep the original's calibration stage unchanged
later: after the tracking and camera loops are split
items.recommendation: later, so the frame-loss work goes first

items.question: The new autofocus loop in D1_s3_loop15.vi has three limits (STATUS OPEN 58). (1) Frame rate = 1 focuses only once. (2) A rerun without reopening can skip the first autofocus. (3) If the loop falls more than one frame behind, that one autofocus is skipped. Do any of these matter for your experiments?
items.recommendation: none matter, since focus values are not saved data

items.question: D1_s3_loop15.vi gives the same X/Y/Z as the original on 10,310 recorded frames, but it has never run with real beads. Will you run it once with beads while you watch, so it can become a file you actually use?
options: yes, tell me when it is ready
not yet, finish the loop-1.2 and camera splits first
no, keep using the original until the whole project is done
items.recommendation: yes, after cycle 83's load measurement shows whether it loses fewer frames
